name: ugarit-grc-eng
description: Word alignments of Ancient Greek and English by two domain experts on the Ugarit editor (inter-annotator agreement above 80%): Iliad 1 (Murray 1924), Plato's Crito (Fowler 1966), Xenophon's Cyropaedia 1 (Miller 1914). 274 sentences, 6,036 sure and 1,388 possible links.
